regime_context: The detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative tape: only 2 of 22 themes are absolute-trend eligible, and Coal leads Banks by a hair (margin 0.027) with low breadth (0.3) and a mean-revert Hurst tag. The validated drawdown gate did NOT hold on this A-share history (gate_helps=false), so the entire read is experimental; cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0. Given only ~2% eligibles and an unscorable challenger texture, I hold very few directional leans and keep conviction low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (rank #3, eligible=false, scorable=false) or SOE Blue Chips (rank #4, eligible=false, crowded=true) become eligible again via a trend-gate pass; the observable that retires the watch is either theme posting a confirmed absolute-trend eligibility flip, which would mark the first sign of leadership broadening beyond the Coal-Banks duo.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only scorable, absolute-trend-eligible theme and the headline leader. Its eligibility (trend gate) plus rank-1 score is the only leg supporting a lean, and the gate is unreliable on this market, so this is a modest expression that the prevailing narrative persists long enough to avoid a shake-out, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert and durability_bar is only 0.48 with breadth 0.3 — the leader is not healthy on cohesion, and a mean-reverting tape has historically whipsawed the trend gate, suggesting Coal leadership may reverse rather than persist.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS lags the CSI 300 by 3% or more over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the ONLY other eligible theme and rank #2 with a 0.8 durability bar (highest on the board) and 0.778 breadth — the healthiest challenger — but crowding_z of 1.77 flags crowded=true. Guardrails forbid fading the leader on crowding, so the honest read is to avoid adding/chasing Banks here rather than lean under or over; the crowding is a size-down caution, not a short.
theses.dissent: If the one-narrative Coal regime rolls over on its mean-revert tag, the challenger with the strongest durability (Banks) becomes the most credible confirmed-handoff destination — avoiding it now forfeits that optionality, and crowding flags have no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS prints a positive 10-day return while simultaneously leading the rotation margin over Coal by more than 0.3 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
